name: padding-alpha-contain-opaque-background
notes: Existing 96x64 alpha PNG has alpha values 0, 85, 170, 255; embed its original bytes without transcoding.
Opaque authored image background must paint the outer padding and the letterbox visible through the inner clip owner. Source alpha must composite over that same background.
Integral intended geometry: outer 216x176, content 192x160 at(12,8); contain scales the asset 2x to 192x128 at content offset(0,32). The following 8x8 tail starts at y=176.
This is an additional finite composition control; compilation/API parity is separate from native pixel qualification.

name: padding-alpha-cover-translucent-background
notes: Existing 96x64 alpha PNG has alpha values 0, 85, 170, 255; embed its original bytes without transcoding.
A translucent authored image background composites once over the colored parent. Source alpha then composites over that result; the unnamed inner owner must not repaint the background.

Integral intended geometry: content 96x48 at(16,12), outer 128x72. Cover keeps the asset at 1x, crops 8px from each vertical end, and must clip source pixels before they enter padding. The following 8x8 tail starts at y=72.
This isolates new owner/clip/alpha composition with current admitted image syntax; it adds no format or sampling-mode scope.
